Qt 6.10.3 — corresponding source and replacement instructions
==========================================================

Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.
Qt is used under LGPL-3.0-only. Third-party portions keep their own licenses.
M2CL project-specific additional terms do not apply to these portions.

SOURCE DELIVERY

For a binary release using this Qt baseline, provide these companion archives
at the same download location and with equivalent access as the binary:

  qt-6.10.3-corresponding-source.zip
  m2cl-0.1.0-source.zip

The first contains the unchanged Qt module source archives, license notices,
source checksums and upstream SDK build configuration. The second contains
the application's public source, resources and build scripts. Neither archive
contains credentials, local game installations or the development toolchain.
Run the preparation tool AFTER finalizing the source used for that binary:

  python3 tools/prepare_source_bundles.py --source-cache /path/to/qt-source-cache

The tool verifies every Qt archive before making the companion files. It uses
the current non-ignored public working tree, so run it from the exact source
snapshot being released. Include the generated SHA256SUMS file. Keep these
sources available as required by the applicable licenses. This document is
not a written offer to supply sources that have not actually been provided.

UPSTREAM SOURCES (also recorded in sources.json)

https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.10/6.10.3/submodules/qtbase-everywhere-src-6.10.3.tar.xz
SHA-256: 383dc907816338f0cba72088a524c07458dfc69ce684ca9132fcc4fe91c24b0b

https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.10/6.10.3/submodules/qtsvg-everywhere-src-6.10.3.tar.xz
SHA-256: b3223fe005f6a4c7f21f34e4ee6ce0094737cff9503ba15bbb171ac18794f76d

https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.10/6.10.3/submodules/qtimageformats-everywhere-src-6.10.3.tar.xz
SHA-256: 84605dd91037482b5b7c7ecc5c27aee8acc1cd7f1fe77bc564777ddf365d7d28

The source comparison against the official SDK's source SPDX checksums is
recorded in components.json. Only release-stamp .tag differences are allowed;
compiled source differences fail the notice collection tool. No Qt source
patches were applied for this build. QT-BUILD-CONFIG.txt preserves the upstream
SDK configuration; its /Users/qt paths refer to Qt's build infrastructure,
not M2CL users or local accounts.

REBUILDING AND USING MODIFIED QT

M2CL does not impose a restriction on replacing Qt with an interface-compatible
modified version, rebuilding/relinking M2CL with it, or reverse engineering for
debugging such modifications as permitted by LGPLv3. Application source and
resources are provided, so relinking does not require proprietary object files.

For macOS, install Xcode command line tools, CMake 3.21+, Ninja and zlib. Unpack
the three Qt source tar.xz files. In a separate build directory configure and
build qtbase. Replace source/prefix placeholders with absolute paths:

  /path/to/qtbase-everywhere-src-6.10.3/configure -prefix /path/to/modified-qt -opensource -confirm-license -release -framework -nomake examples -nomake tests
  cmake --build . --parallel
  cmake --install .

For EACH of qtsvg and qtimageformats, use another empty build directory:

  /path/to/modified-qt/bin/qt-configure-module /path/to/module-source
  cmake --build . --parallel
  cmake --install .

Use an architecture compatible with the application (native arm64 on Apple
Silicon, or x86_64 on Intel). Qt's distributed SDK is universal; its exact flags
are in QT-BUILD-CONFIG.txt. A native rebuild is sufficient when rebuilding M2CL
for the same native architecture. Consult Qt's source README for any additional
platform toolchain prerequisites.

To compile M2CL language catalogs, use a compatible Qt LinguistTools SDK as a
host tool (or build qttools and its required development dependencies). Then
configure M2CL against the modified Qt installation, NOT the original runtime:

  cmake -S /path/to/m2cl-source -B /path/to/m2cl-custom-build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/path/to/modified-qt -DMCLAUNCHER_QT_MAJOR=6 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  cmake --build /path/to/m2cl-custom-build --parallel

If LinguistTools was installed in a separate compatible SDK, additionally pass
-DQt6LinguistTools_DIR=/path/to/host-sdk/lib/cmake/Qt6LinguistTools. That SDK's
lupdate/lrelease may need its development dependencies installed; these are
host tools, not extra libraries to bundle with the launcher.

The result is m2cl-custom-build/m2cl.app. Run that rebuild directly, or deploy
its matching frameworks and plugins using modified-qt/bin/macdeployqt. Qt
frameworks live in Contents/Frameworks and plugins in Contents/PlugIns in a
deployed application. Keep compatible libraries/plugins together. Replacing
files in a signed bundle invalidates its signature; a local rebuilt copy can
be signed with the user's own identity or an ad-hoc signature as appropriate.
M2CL's current build does not enable hardened-runtime library validation or
require a private vendor signing key to build and run a local modified copy.

For Windows/Linux, follow docs/build-and-validation.md with the appropriate
compiler and SDK. Their platform plugins/system dependencies and any runtime
libraries copied into the final package must be inventoried separately. This
macOS baseline is not an assertion that those packages have been audited.

NOTICES AND TOOLS

Complete LGPLv3 and GPLv3 are in LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt. Original third-party
notices are in original/ and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. Source links/checksums are
in sources.json; SDK dependencies are in components.json.

To reproduce the notices with the matching official SDK and verified sources:

  python3 tools/collect_qt_notices.py --qt-prefix /path/to/Qt/6.10.3/macos --source-cache /path/to/qt-source-cache

This collection/preparation is explicit and offline; ordinary builds never
download Qt sources automatically. See README.md in this directory for the
Chinese summary and official Qt documentation links.
